note: The Lagoon 42's rebuild (docs/lagoon42-2 on). Slice 1 builds the two hull shells, their sugar-scoop treads and risers (L42_Hull) and the outboard hull windows (L42_HullWindows), and a flat lid at the sheer (L42_DeckPlaceholder, section 'placeholder', not budgeted) that slice 3's deck replaces; slice 2 (docs/lagoon42-3) the bridge deck with its nose and foredeck (L42_Bridgedeck), the crossbeam and centre beam (L42_Crossbeam), the bowsprit (L42_Bowsprit) and the trampolines (L42_Trampolines), with a flat lid over the bridge deck aft of the foredeck (L42_BridgeLidPlaceholder, 'placeholder') until slices 3 and 4; later slices add their parts here (bridgedeck, coachroof, cockpit, keels, rig, sails, fittings, saloon: the size card's budget_triangles.sections). Rules as in sections_j22.json: an entry ending in '_' or '*' is a name prefix, any other an exact name; unmatched is 'other'.
joins_note: The bridge deck, the crossbeam and the trampolines end on the hulls' inboard topsides (bridgedeck_lagoon42.span), the bridge deck's foredeck and lid on their inboard sheer: no joins are checked by a tool yet.
